name: Evil Kermit
look: Kermit the Frog, seen from behind at left, faces a look-alike frog on the right wearing a black hood that shadows the top of its face. The scene is dim, with a plain dark gray background.
use: A conversation with your own dark side. Normal Kermit is labeled as me with a sensible intention, and the hooded Kermit is the inner voice that tempts me into the lazy, petty or bad choice.
slots: top caption: me, with a good intention (normal Kermit)
bottom caption: my dark side urging the bad choice (hooded Kermit)
examples: Me: I should go to bed early tonight
Me to me: One more episode won't hurt
Me: I'm saving money this month
Also me: Treat yourself, you earned it
describe: kermit talking to a hooded dark version of himself
frog puppet facing his twin in a black hood
muppet frog and his sinister cloaked double
kermit listening to his bad inner voice in a hood
green frog with a shadowy hooded frog whispering temptation
origin: A still from the 2014 film Muppets Most Wanted, where Kermit meets a hooded look-alike.
